name: Arcade
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Arcade games from your Omarchy bar. Brick Blitz, an original brick-breaker, plays the moment you install, with nothing else needed. Pac-Man, Galaga and Super Street Fighter II launch in MAME from your own ROM files: Arcade checks your ROMs and tells you exactly what is missing. It never downloads or links to games. Free, MIT licensed, no account. An Omarchy.Fans product by ModPunk.
